aboutParagraphOne: Many businesses sell goods to customers on credit. The challenge begins when there are many customers, different due dates, and debts that are easy to forget.
aboutParagraphTwo: LENEX gives business owners one simple place to record and follow those debts, helping them stay organized and make better decisions.
